title: Interleaving distances from height-difference functions on posets
summary: Interleaving distances provide a fundamental tool for comparing persistence modules and have been widely used in topological data analysis. Their definitions are typically based on translation structures (shift operations) on the indexing poset, but on general posets such structures can be scarce, making this framework restrictive. In this paper, we introduce a new interleaving-type distance for functor categories over arbitrary posets, induced by a height-difference function $ρ$.
